title: Greek Salad
description: Crunchy tomato, cucumber, and red onion with a slab of feta, olives, and good olive oil.
steps: Chop the tomatoes and cucumber into chunks; thinly slice the red onion.
Combine in a bowl with the olives.
Top with a slab of feta, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with oregano and salt.
